column1: Heat a large 12-inch skillet over medium heat.
Combine 3/4 tsp salt with the coriander, cinnamon, nutmeg, dried thyme, and pepper, then season both sides of the chicken.
Add a drizzle of oil to the skillet and cook the chicken about 5 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F (74°C). Set aside, loosely covered.
Melt the butter in the same pan, then add the brown sugar, apples, shallots, and remaining 1/4 tsp salt. Cook about 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until the apples start to soften.
Pour in the apple cider and simmer about 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken to the pan and warm for 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken topped with the apples and sauce, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
